title: 03. The Helpful Patrol Car
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Wee-oo, wee-oo! Red and blue lights flash on the roof of a white-and-blue car as it races past. Hori's ears perk up. Wow! What's that flashing car? Wee-oo, wee-oo! The patrol car is on its way!
Mom, where is that patrol car going in such a hurry? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Mom's hand. Mom smiles. If you're curious, shall we visit the place where patrol cars live? Bori can come, too!

White-and-blue patrol cars stand side by side outside the police station. Hello! Have you come to learn about patrol cars? A police officer in a blue uniform and a smart hat waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

Those flashing red and blue lights are warning lights. When we hurry to help someone, they say, Please make way! The siren sounds as well, so people can see and hear us from far away. Hori's eyes sparkle.

The officer taps a small box on one shoulder. This is a radio. Crackle! When I speak into it, other officers far away can hear me right away. We tell each other where help is needed. Bori asks quietly, Can it help you find a thief, too? Yes! We work together.

The officer opens the driver's door, revealing a round steering wheel. We turn this wheel as we go on patrol. Going on patrol means traveling around the neighborhood to check that everyone is safe. Wee-oo, wee-oo! Hori's heart races with excitement.

Would Hori like to sit here like an officer? Hori climbs into the driver's seat and holds the wheel with both hands. Vroom, vroom! He imagines keeping the neighborhood safe. Into the radio, he says clearly, Hori's patrol car here! I'm ready to help! Bori smiles in the passenger seat.

Want to press this button? Hori and the officer press it together, and red and blue warning lights flash on the roof! Hori's tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. Wow! I switched them on! Wee-oo, wee-oo! The patrol car is on its way!

Then the radio crackles. Please help us find a lost child. The officer climbs into the patrol car and holds the wheel. Wee-oo, wee-oo! With flashing lights, the car sets off. Hori and Bori wave. Take care!

On the way home, Hori holds Mom's hand and chats. The warning lights give a signal, the radio keeps officers in touch, and the steering wheel helps them drive on patrol! Police officers look after our neighborhood. Hori smiles at the sky. Wee-oo, wee-oo! The patrol car is on its way!
